author: Pallas, 1776
habitat: 관목림, 덤불, 잡목림, 농경지와 개활지의 관목·덤불
summary: 5월과 9~11월에 작은 무리를 지어 한반도를 지나가는 흔치 않은 나그네새이다. 관목림과 덤불, 잡목림에 살며, 봄가을 이동 시기에는 농경지나 트인 땅의 관목·덤불, 잡목림에서 눈에 띈다. 곤충과 식물 씨앗을 먹는다. 구북구 동부, 바이칼, 스타노보이 산맥 등지에서 번식하고 중국 남부에서 겨울을 난다.

points.en: brown streaks running from breast to flanks
white belly and pale brown flanks

sexes.male: 여름깃은 머리가 검고 눈썹선이 노랗다. 턱밑은 희고 등은 흑갈색 세로줄이 있는 갈색이다.

art.subject: Yellow-browed Bunting (Emberiza chrysophrys), adult male in breeding plumage, as seen on spring migration in Korea in May: head black with a narrow white median crown stripe; a broad supercilium, bright yellow in front of and above the eye and fading to white towards the nape; white submoustachial stripe and black malar stripe; white chin and throat; mantle brown streaked blackish-brown; two whitish wing-bars; underparts white with fine dark-brown streaks running from the breast onto the pale brown flanks; tail dark brown with white outer feathers. Conical bill pinkish with a dark culmen; dark eye; pinkish legs.
art.pose: perched in a low shrub at the edge of a field
art.scene: Korean spring migration in May: low thickets and scrubby woodland edge bordering farmland, fresh green leaves; no people, buildings or text
views: adult male breeding, side view perched in a low shrub: black head with a thin white median crown stripe, yellow supercilium turning white at the rear, white chin, black malar, streaked brown back, white belly, fine brown streaks from the breast to the pale brown flanks
adult female, side view perched: the same pattern but paler, with brown crown and ear-coverts instead of black, duller yellow supercilium, white chin and finely streaked breast and flanks
art.build: Small bunting, 14cm, about the size of a sparrow but slimmer; rounded head, the crown feathers sometimes slightly raised. Bill conical and pointed, shorter than the head. Legs pinkish, medium length. Tail medium length and notched, dark with white outer feathers shown in flight. Keeps to low scrub and the ground under bushes, usually in small groups.
avoid: Do not paint a yellow throat, a crest or a black breast patch; those belong to Yellow-throated Bunting (Emberiza elegans).
Do not make the supercilium all white or the throat black; that is Tristram's Bunting (Emberiza tristrami).
Do not paint the supercilium yellow all the way to the nape; the yellow is strongest in front of and above the eye and turns white behind.
